concepts.gloss_en: the sparkling/radiating of the light of the merit of the Patriarchs (zechut avot)

reason_for_human: All three forms describe the identical phenomenon — the light of the Patriarchs' merit sparkling to draw down the holiness of Eretz Yisrael — in the same lesson (LM 55). The only differences are grammatical: the verbal noun התנוצצות, the participle מתנוצץ, and the same participle with the prefix כש ("when"), all from root נ-צ-צ (hitpael). Same word, same concept, mere inflectional/syntactic variation.
